children: Chen Wen-Chang (Victor), an Officer serving as Chief Strategy Officer, sold 117,461 ordinary shares in a transaction reported on 2026-09-15. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $26.5964 per share, with individual sale prices ranging from $26.54 to $26.663. The total sale amount reported was $3,124,039. After the transaction, Chen directly owned 434,855 ordinary shares. The shares were sold pursuant to a sell-to-cover transaction to cover the exercise price of stock options plus related taxes and fees.
